bullets: AI coding assistant now stops early after 40 consecutive steps with no progress, ending with a clear message instead of wasting credits.
The maximum steps for the main AI assistant in a single turn has increased from 200 to 600.
Archived chat errors now distinguish between files recoverable by messaging, files recoverable only via desktop export, and permanently lost files.
Old confusing interruption errors on desktop have been replaced with specific messages explaining the exact reason a task stopped.
